en.title: EthioIntel: Policy Intelligence
en.subtitle: Actionable, data-backed insights for Ethiopian national development — ten high-impact dashboards for government and stakeholders.
en.sourceNote: National totals refresh from the World Bank WDI when reachable. Regional scores, corridor times, housing stocks, and incubator counts are compiled from the latest published ESS, EDHS, FAO, WFP, ILO, GSMA, IPDC, NMA, and NDRMC tables — they are not live administrative feeds. Treat directional patterns as decision support, not a census.

am.title: ኢትዮኢንቴል፡ የፖሊሲ ብልህነት
am.subtitle: ለኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ልማት ተግባራዊና በውሂብ የተደገፉ ግንዛቤዎች — ለመንግሥትና ለባለድርሻ አካላት አሥር ከፍተኛ ተፅዕኖ ያላቸው ዳሽቦርዶች።
am.sourceNote: የሀገር ደረጃ ቁጥሮች ከዓለም ባንክ WDI ሲገኙ ይዘምናሉ። የክልል ነጥቦች፣ የኮሪደር ጊዜዎች፣ የመኖሪያ ቤት ክምችትና የኢንኩቤተር ብዛት ከESS፣ EDHS፣ FAO፣ WFP፣ ILO፣ GSMA፣ IPDC፣ NMA እና NDRMC የታተሙ ሰንጠረዦች የተጠናቀሩ ናቸው — ቀጥታ የአስተዳደር መረጃ አይደሉም።

goal.en: Identify diversification opportunities and address declining sectors.
goal.am: የልዩነት ዕድሎችን መለየት እና እየቀነሱ ያሉ ዘርፎችን መፍታት።

overview.en: Ethiopia’s growth engine is shifting. Agriculture still employs most workers, but industry now supplies the largest contribution to real GDP growth. Tracking yearly sectoral contributions shows where diversification is working — and where jobs have not yet followed output.
overview.am: የኢትዮጵያ ዕድገት ሞተር እየተቀየረ ነው። ግብርና አሁንም ብዙ ሠራተኞችን ይቀጥራል፤ ኢንዱስትሪ ግን ለእውነተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ዕድገት ትልቁን ድርሻ እየሰጠ ነው። ዓመታዊ የዘርፍ ድርሻ ልዩነት የት እንደሚሠራ እና ሥራ ከውጤት ጋር ያልተጣጣመበትን ያሳያል።

definition.en: Annual change in GDP at constant prices.
definition.am: በቋሚ ዋጋ የጠቅላላ ምርት ዓመታዊ ለውጥ።

definition.en: Value added in agriculture, forestry and fishing as % of GDP.
definition.am: የግብርና፣ ደንና አሳ ዋጋ መጨመር እንደ % የጠቅላላ ምርት።

definition.en: Manufacturing, construction, mining and utilities as % of GDP.
definition.am: ማኑፋክቸሪንግ፣ ግንባታ፣ ማዕድንና መገልገያዎች እንደ % የጠቅላላ ምርት።

definition.en: Wholesale, transport, public and other services as % of GDP.
definition.am: ንግድ፣ ትራንስፖርት፣ መንግሥታዊና ሌሎች አገልግሎቶች እንደ % የጠቅላላ ምርት።

primary.name: National Bank of Ethiopia, annual report

secondary.name: African Development Bank, African Economic Outlook

methodology.en: Growth contributions are from the World Bank FY series (percentage points). GDP shares are WDI value-added. Employment shares use ILO modelled estimates where ESS labour force survey vintages lag.
methodology.am: የዕድገት ድርሻ ከዓለም ባንክ የበጀት ዓመት ተከታታይ ነው። የጠቅላላ ምርት ድርሻ ከWDI ነው። የሥራ ድርሻ የILO ሞዴል ግምቶችን ይጠቀማል።

seriesTitle.en: Contribution to real GDP growth, pp

title.en: Industry now leads growth, not jobs
title.am: ኢንዱስትሪ ዕድገትን ይመራል እንጂ ሥራን አይደለም

body.en: Industry contributed 3.8 percentage points of FY2025 growth (World Bank EEU, 2026) while employing under 9% of workers. The diversification signal is real; the labour-market transmission is not.
body.am: ኢንዱስትሪ በ2017 ዓ.ም. ዕድገት 3.8 ነጥብ አበርክቷል፤ ከ9% በታች ሠራተኞችን ግን ይቀጥራል። የልዩነት ምልክት እውነተኛ ነው፤ ወደ የሥራ ገበያው ምላሽ ግን አልደረሰም።

body.en: Use spare capacity at Hawassa, Bole Lemi, Kilinto and Dire Dawa parks for coffee, oilseed and horticulture processing. This is the shortest path from a 60% agricultural workforce to tradable industrial jobs.
body.am: በሐዋሳ፣ ቦሌ ለሚ፣ ኪሊንቶና ድሬ ዳዋ ፓርኮች ነፃ አቅምን ለቡና፣ ቅባት ዘርና አትክልት ማቀነባበሪያ ይጠቀሙ። ከ60% የግብርና ሠራተኛ ወደ ኢንዱስትሪ ሥራ አጭሩ መንገድ ነው።

body.en: Tie IPDC occupancy, development-bank working capital, and TVET placements to a published manufacturing share target. Hypothetical: lifting manufacturing’s GDP share 5 points while holding ag output steady would absorb a meaningful share of new labour-force entrants without sacrificing food supply.
body.am: የIPDC ስራ ላይ መዋል፣ የልማት ባንክ ካፒታል እና የTVET ምደባን ከታተመ የማኑፋክቸሪንግ ድርሻ ግብ ጋር ያያይዙ።

body.en: ESS national accounts follow the Ethiopian fiscal year; WDI often reports calendar years. Comparisons across sources can shift a point or more.
body.am: ESS የኢትዮጵያ በጀት ዓመት ይከተላል፤ WDI ብዙ ጊዜ የቀን መቁጠሪያ ዓመት ያቀርባል።

body.en: A large urban informal services sector is only partly captured in value-added, so the jobs–output gap in industry looks even wider than it is.
body.am: ትልቅ የከተማ መደበኛ ያልሆነ አገልግሎት በዋጋ መጨመር በከፊል ብቻ ይያዛል።

goal.en: Prioritize infrastructure rollout in underserved but high-potential regions.
goal.am: በአገልግሎት ያልተሸፈኑ ግን ከፍተኛ አቅም ባላቸው ክልሎች መሠረተ ልማትን ቅድሚያ መስጠት።

overview.en: National internet use remains low — about 22% of the population in 2024 — while the median Ethiopian is 19. Mapping penetration against youth employment and firm density shows where a kilometre of fibre or a 4G upgrade would unlock jobs, not just connectivity.
overview.am: የሀገር ደረጃ የኢንተርኔት አጠቃቀም ዝቅተኛ ነው — በ2024 ወደ 22% — መካከለኛ ዕድሜው 19 ነው። ሽፋንን ከወጣት ሥራ እና ከድርጅት ጥግግት ጋር ማነጻጸር ፋይበር ወይም 4G የት ሥራ እንደሚፈጥር ያሳያል።

definition.en: Individuals using the internet, % of population.
Mobile cellular subscriptions per 100 people.
Ratio of estimated internet use in Addis Ababa versus Afar/Somali.
definition.am: በአዲስ አበባና በአፋር/ሶማሌ የተገመተ የአጠቃቀም ሬሾ።

metrics.source: Compiled from Ethio Telecom / GSMA / ESS ICT, latest

definition.en: Population aged 15–29 as a share of total.
definition.am: ከ15–29 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያለው ሕዝብ ድርሻ።

primary.name: Ethiopian Statistical Service, ICT access modules

methodology.en: National penetration is WDI. Regional scores are a composite of urbanisation, Ethio Telecom coverage claims, and GSMA cluster estimates — a proxy where woreda-level subscriber data are not public.
methodology.am: የሀገር ሽፋን ከWDI ነው። የክልል ነጥቦች የከተማነት፣ የኢትዮ ቴሌኮም ሽፋን እና GSMA ግምቶች ውህድ ናቸው።

mixTitle.en: Where to roll out first (priority weight)

pairTitle.en: Internet access vs urban youth job pressure

title.en: Secondary industrial cities are the highest-ROI mile

body.en: Hawassa, Dire Dawa, Kombolcha and Adama combine park employment, youth in-migration, and incomplete 4G/fibre. A 10-point rise in internet use in these cities is a plausible path to digital services jobs supporting park supply chains.
body.am: ሐዋሳ፣ ድሬ ዳዋ፣ ኮምቦልቻና አዳማ የፓርክ ሥራ፣ የወጣት ፍልሰት እና ያልተሟላ 4G/ፋይበር ያጣምራሉ።

body.en: Pair logistics upgrades with last-mile access in corridor towns. The same trench can carry trade data and household connectivity.
body.am: የሎጂስቲክስ ማሻሻያን ከኮሪደር ከተሞች መጨረሻ-ማይል ጋር ያጣምሩ።

body.en: Hypothetical: raising internet use 10 points in 12 secondary cities, bundled with TVET digital modules, could create tens of thousands of remote and platform jobs — if power reliability is sequenced in parallel (see Energy dashboard).
body.am: በ12 ሁለተኛ ከተሞች ኢንተርኔትን 10 ነጥብ ማሳደግ ከTVET ዲጂታል ሞጁሎች ጋር በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሥራዎችን ሊፈጥር ይችላል።

body.en: Ethio Telecom does not release a stable open subscriber-by-woreda series. Regional ranks here are a documented proxy, not a census of SIMs.
body.am: ኢትዮ ቴሌኮም የተረጋጋ ክፍት የወረዳ ተመዝጋቢ ተከታታይ አያወጣም።

body.en: WDI counts users, not quality. A 3G signal that drops during load-shedding is counted the same as fibre.
body.am: WDI ተጠቃሚዎችን ይቆጥራል እንጂ ጥራትን አይደለም።

goal.en: Recommend targeted vocational training in regions with skill mismatches.
goal.am: የክህሎት አለመጣጣም ባለባቸው ክልሎች የታለመ የሙያ ስልጠና መምከር።

overview.en: Adult literacy has climbed to about 60%, but employability has not moved in lockstep. The binding constraint is often not the alphabet — it is a mismatch between general schooling and the skills industrial parks, logistics firms, and commercial farms actually hire.
overview.am: የአዋቂዎች ማንበብና መጻፍ ወደ 60% ደርሷል፤ የሥራ ብቃት ግን አብሮ አልተንቀሳቀሰም። ችግሩ ፊደል ሳይሆን አጠቃላይ ትምህርት ከኢንዱስትሪ ፓርኮች፣ ሎጂስቲክስና የንግድ እርሻ የሚቀጥሩት ክህሎት ጋር አለመጣጣም ነው።

definition.en: Literacy rate, adult total (% of people ages 15 and above).
Literacy among 15–24 year-olds.

metrics.source: World Bank WDI / UNESCO UIS, latest

definition.en: Relative enrolment in technical-vocational vs academic tertiary.
Male minus female adult literacy, national.

methodology.en: Literacy is survey-based and lags (latest WDI adult rate is 2022). Regional employability scores combine urban unemployment, park proximity, and TVET seat density.
methodology.am: ማንበብና መጻፍ በዳሰሳ ላይ የተመሠረተ ነው (የWDI አዋቂ መጠን 2022)።

title.en: High literacy, high unemployment is a TVET problem
title.am: ከፍተኛ ማንበብ፣ ከፍተኛ ሥራ አጥነት የTVET ችግር ነው

body.en: Addis and large Amhara/Oromia towns show relatively high literacy and high urban youth job pressure. That is a conversion problem: general schooling is not translating into park, logistics, and construction skills.
body.am: አዲስ እና ትላልቅ የአማራ/ኦሮሚያ ከተሞች ከፍተኛ ማንበብና ከፍተኛ የከተማ ወጣት ሥራ ጫና ያሳያሉ።

title.en: Park-tied TVET seats this academic year
title.am: በዚህ ዓመት ከፓርክ ጋር የተያያዙ TVET መቀመጫዎች

body.en: Co-locate short courses (industrial sewing, machine maintenance, warehouse ops, electrical) at Hawassa, Bole Lemi and Kombolcha. Firms already know the vacancy list.
body.am: አጭር ኮርሶችን (ስፌት፣ ማሽን ጥገና፣ መጋዘን፣ ኤሌክትሪክ) በሐዋሳ፣ ቦሌ ለሚና ኮምቦልቻ ያስቀምጡ።

title.en: Fund mismatch regions, not only low-literacy regions
title.am: ዝቅተኛ ማንበብ ብቻ ሳይሆን አለመጣጣም ክልሎችን ይደግፉ

body.en: Hypothetical: shifting 15% of new TVET seats toward high-literacy/high-unemployment woredas could raise park fill-rates within two hiring seasons, while pastoral regions still need first-generation literacy.
body.am: 15% አዲስ የTVET መቀመጫዎችን ወደ ከፍተኛ ማንበብ/ከፍተኛ ሥራ አጥነት ወረዳዎች ማዘዋወር የፓርክ ስራ ላይ መዋልን ሊያሻሽል ይችላል።

body.en: The WDI adult literacy point is 2022. Conflict, displacement, and school closures since then are not in the national rate.
body.am: የWDI አዋቂ ማንበብ ነጥብ 2022 ነው። ከዚያ በኋላ ግጭትና የትምህርት ቤት መዘጋት በሀገር መጠን ውስጥ የሉም።

body.en: Few agencies publish job-placement rates by occupation. Employability is inferred from labour-force surveys.
body.am: ጥቂት ኤጀንሲዎች በሙያ የሥራ ምደባ መጠን ያወጣሉ።

goal.en: Diversify crops and create early-warning systems for climate risks.
goal.am: ሰብሎችን ማስፋት እና ለአየር ስጋት የቅድመ ማስጠንቀቂያ መፍጠር።

overview.en: Coffee still anchors agricultural foreign exchange, but rainfall volatility in producing belts and a shifting overall export mix (mining now rivals farms in some years) make crop concentration a strategic risk. Overlaying volumes with NMA climate signals is the start of an early-warning system, not just a trade dashboard.
overview.am: ቡና አሁንም የግብርና ውጭ ምንዛሬን ይይዛል፤ በምርት ቀበቶዎች የዝናብ መዋዠቅ እና የወጪ ንግድ ስብጥር መቀየር ግን የሰብል መጠንጣጣን ስትራቴጂያዊ ስጋት ያደርገዋል።

definition.en: Share of agricultural export value from coffee in recent seasons.
definition.am: ከቡና የግብርና ወጪ ንግድ ዋጋ ድርሻ።

metrics.source: Ethiopian Coffee & Tea Authority / NBE, latest season

definition.en: Reported agricultural export receipts in the most recent full year.
definition.am: በቅርብ ሙሉ ዓመት የተመዘገበ የግብርና ወጪ ገቢ።

definition.en: Deviation from long-run kiremt mean in major producing zones.
Concentration of ag export value in the top two commodities.

primary.name: National Bank of Ethiopia, trade statistics

methodology.en: Export mix is compiled from NBE and ECTA public totals; monthly customs microdata are not open. Climate overlay uses NMA seasonal outlooks plus CHIRPS-style rainfall as a proxy where station files are delayed.
methodology.am: የወጪ ስብጥር ከNBE እና ECTA ነው። የአየር ሽፋን የNMA ወቅታዊ ትንበያዎችን ይጠቀማል።

title.en: Coffee concentration is a climate position

body.en: Nearly half of agricultural export value sits in coffee belts that are sensitive to kiremt timing. A poor belg or a late kiremt is a balance-of-payments event, not only a farm event.
body.am: የግብርና ወጪ ዋጋ ግማሽ ያህል በክረምት ጊዜ ላይ ሚስጥራዊ በሆኑ የቡና ቀበቶዎች ይቀመጣል።

body.en: Issue a joint monthly note to cooperatives and banks: rainfall anomaly, pest watch, and indicative farmgate prices. Low cost, high coordination value.
body.am: ለህብረት ሥራ ማህበራትና ባንኮች ወርሃዊ ማስታወሻ፦ የዝናብ ልዩነት፣ ተባይ እና የእርሻ ዋጋ።

body.en: Hypothetical: shifting 10% of coffee export value into washed/processed grades and expanding irrigated sesame in lowland belts could cut drought-year FX losses by a visible margin while raising unit value.
body.am: 10% የቡና ወጪ ዋጋን ወደ የታጠበ/የተቀነባበረ ደረጃ ማዛወር እና የሰሊጥ መስኖ ማስፋት የድርቅ ዓመት ኪሳራን ሊቀንስ ይችላል።

body.en: Public dashboards must use aggregated NBE/ECTA totals. Volume–grade–origin detail needed for true early warning is delayed.
body.am: ክፍት ዳሽቦርዶች የተጠቃለሉ NBE/ECTA ድምሮችን መጠቀም አለባቸው።

body.en: NMA station files can lag. Satellite rainfall is a usable proxy but understates local orographic effects in coffee highlands.
body.am: የNMA ጣቢያ ፋይሎች ሊዘገዩ ይችላሉ።

goal.en: Target food aid and irrigation projects to high-risk regions.
goal.am: የምግብ እርዳታና መስኖን ወደ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ክልሎች ማቅናት።

overview.en: Childhood stunting remains one of Ethiopia’s most expensive long-run constraints. Overlaying nutrition outcomes with agricultural productivity and health-facility access shows where food aid, irrigation, and primary care should move together — especially in pastoral and conflict-affected belts.
overview.am: የሕጻናት የእድገት መቆም ከኢትዮጵያ ረጅም ጊዜ ውድ ገደቦች አንዱ ነው። የተመጣጠነ ምግብን ከግብርና ምርታማነትና ከጤና ተቋም መዳረሻ ጋር ማደራረብ የት እርዳታ፣ መስኖና የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ እንክብካቤ አብረው መሄድ እንዳለባቸው ያሳያል።

definition.en: Height-for-age below -2 SD, children under five.
Weight-for-height below -2 SD.
People in IPC/CH phase 3+ at seasonal peak.
Antenatal care coverage as a facility-access proxy.
definition.am: የቅድመ ወሊድ እንክብካቤ እንደ ተቋም መዳረሻ ውክልና።

secondary.name: Ministry of Agriculture, food security directorate
Local NGO operational data (use with caution)

methodology.en: Stunting is slow-moving (survey years). Wasting and IPC caseloads move with seasons and conflict. Regional scores blend last EDHS zone figures with recent WFP hotspot lists — labelled as a composite, not a new survey.
methodology.am: የእድገት መቆም በዝግታ ይንቀሳቀሳል። ክብደት መቀነስና IPC ከወቅትና ግጭት ጋር ይንቀሳቀሳሉ።

title.en: Aid without water restocks the same hotspot
title.am: ያለ ውሃ እርዳታ ተመሳሳይ ቦታን ይሞላል

body.en: Afar and Somali combine high wasting risk with thin facility coverage and low irrigation. Food aid is necessary in the lean season; without water and CMAM it does not change the next survey.
body.am: አፋርና ሶማሌ ከፍተኛ የክብደት መቀነስ ስጋትን ከቀጭን ተቋም ሽፋን ጋር ያጣምራሉ።

title.en: Co-locate CMAM with food distribution points

body.en: Use existing WFP/NDRMC distribution sites as screening points. The logistics cost is already paid.
body.am: ነባር የWFP/NDRMC ስርጭት ቦታዎችን እንደ መመርመሪያ ይጠቀሙ።

body.en: Hypothetical: bundling small-scale irrigation with CMAM in the 50 highest-scoring woredas could cut wasting faster than aid alone, while stunting will still take a cohort to move.
body.am: በ50 ከፍተኛ ወረዳዎች መስኖን ከCMAM ጋር ማጣመር ክብደት መቀነስን ከእርዳታ ብቻ በበለጠ ፍጥነት ሊቀንስ ይችላል።

body.en: Full EDHS rounds are years apart. Conflict-affected belts may be under-sampled. Use SMART surveys and HMIS as interim proxies.
body.am: ሙሉ EDHS በዓመታት ይለያያል። የግጭት ቀበቶዎች በበቂ ላይወከሉ ይችላሉ።

body.en: Urban malnutrition is often hidden in informal settlements with outdated enumeration.
body.am: የከተማ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጥረት ብዙ ጊዜ በመደበኛ ባልሆኑ መኖሪያዎች ይደበቃል።

goal.en: Improve logistics efficiency to boost export competitiveness.
goal.am: የወጪ ንግድ ውድድርን ለማሳደግ የሎጂስቲክስ ብቃትን ማሻሻል።

overview.en: Most of Ethiopia’s seaborne trade still funnels through the Djibouti corridor. Freight time, port dwell, and dry-port bottlenecks are a hidden tax on coffee, garments, and industrial-park inputs. Measuring the corridor is measuring export competitiveness.
overview.am: የኢትዮጵያ የባህር ንግድ አብዛኛው አሁንም በጅቡቲ ኮሪደር ይሄዳል። የጭነት ጊዜ፣ የወደብ ቆይታ እና የደረቅ ወደብ ማነቆዎች በቡና፣ ልብስና የኢንዱስትሪ ግብዓት ላይ የተደበቀ ግብር ናቸው።

definition.en: Estimated share of seaborne freight using the Djibouti route.
definition.am: በጅቡቲ መስመር የሚሄድ የባህር ጭነት ድርሻ።

definition.en: World Bank LPI overall score vs regional peers.
Average container dwell at principal dry ports.
definition.am: በዋና ደረቅ ወደቦች አማካይ የኮንቴይነር ቆይታ።

definition.en: Typical TEU road/rail cost relative to distance peers.

methodology.en: Hard corridor times are operational and often unpublished. This dashboard uses publicly cited dwell and LPI figures plus a structured bottleneck list. Treat as a management scorecard until ESLSE releases a stable open series.
methodology.am: የኮሪደር ጊዜዎች ብዙ ጊዜ አይታተሙም። ይህ ዳሽቦርድ የታተሙ LPI እና የማነቆ ዝርዝር ይጠቀማል።

seriesTitle.en: Illustrative transit time index (lower is better)

title.en: Dwell, not distance, is the tax

body.en: Documented diagnostics repeatedly find that paperwork and dry-port handling rival driving time on Addis–Djibouti. Cutting two days of dwell is worth more than shaving kilometres.
body.am: ሰነድና ደረቅ ወደብ አያያዝ በአዲስ–ጅቡቲ የመንዳት ጊዜን ያህል ያወዳድራሉ።

title.en: Single-window at Mojo and Dire Dawa

body.en: Finish and enforce electronic single-window clearance for park exporters. This is process reform, not new asphalt.
body.am: ለፓርክ ወጪ አንድ ኤሌክትሮኒክ መስኮት ያጠናቁ። አዲስ አስፋልት አይደለም፤ የሂደት ማሻሻያ ነው።

body.en: Hypothetical: moving 20% of non-time-critical bulk to Berbera over three years would cap Djibouti disruption risk without abandoning the primary rail investment.
body.am: 20% ጊዜ-አስፈላጊ ያልሆነ ጭነትን በሦስት ዓመት ወደ በርበራ ማዛወር የጅቡቲ ስጋትን ይገድባል።

body.en: Freight times and costs appear in reports, not a stable API. Automated updates need a published monthly table.
body.am: የጭነት ጊዜና ወጪ በሪፖርት ይታያሉ እንጂ በተረጋጋ API አይደለም።

body.en: Port dwell is a Djibouti (or Berbera) statistic. Ethiopia can measure dry ports cleanly; ocean dwell requires partner reporting.
body.am: የወደብ ቆይታ የጅቡቲ (ወይም በርበራ) ስታትስቲክስ ነው።

goal.en: Prioritize off-grid solutions and grid expansion for industrial zones.
goal.am: ከፍርግርግ ውጭ መፍትሄዎችን እና የፍርግርግ መስፋፋትን ለኢንዱስትሪ ዞኖች ቅድሚያ መስጠት።

overview.en: Electrification has risen, but reliability — not just connections — now binds industrial parks. Household access and park megawatt demand are different problems: one is last-mile, the other is firm power. Sequencing both against IPDC zones avoids building factories that wait on feeders.
overview.am: ኤሌክትሪፊኬሽን ከፍ ብሏል፤ አስተማማኝነት ግን — መስመር ብቻ ሳይሆን — የኢንዱስትሪ ፓርኮችን ይገድባል። የቤተሰብ መዳረሻ እና የፓርክ ሜጋዋት ፍላጎት የተለያዩ ችግሮች ናቸው።

definition.en: Population with access to electricity.
Urban access minus rural access.
Contracted and requested MW at operational industrial parks.
definition.am: በሥራ ላይ ባሉ ፓርኮች የተጠየቀ MW።

definition.en: Share of generation from hydropower.

methodology.en: Access is a connection statistic; parks need availability and quality. Regional scores combine access, park presence, and hydro/drought exposure. MW demand by park is only partly public — IPDC reports are the primary source.
methodology.am: መዳረሻ የመስመር ስታትስቲክስ ነው፤ ፓርኮች አቅርቦትና ጥራት ይፈልጋሉ።

mixTitle.en: Where new MW should go first

title.en: Parks fail on reliability, not on the map
title.am: ፓርኮች በአስተማማኝነት ይወድቃሉ እንጂ በካርታ አይደለም

body.en: Hawassa and Bole Lemi sit on the grid and still lose shifts to outages. Household access percentages hide this. Dedicated feeders and on-site backup are the industrial metric.
body.am: ሐዋሳና ቦሌ ለሚ በፍርግርግ ላይ ናቸው አሁንም በመቆራረጥ ፈረቃ ያጣሉ።

title.en: Feeder priority list for five parks

body.en: Publish a weekly outage and MW shortfall table for Hawassa, Bole Lemi, Kilinto, Dire Dawa and Kombolcha. What is measured gets trucks and crews.
body.am: ለሐዋሳ፣ ቦሌ ለሚ፣ ኪሊንቶ፣ ድሬ ዳዋና ኮምቦልቻ ሳምንታዊ የመቆራረጥ ሰንጠረዥ ያውጡ።

title.en: Grid for parks, mini-grids for agro woredas

body.en: Hypothetical: allocating new firm MW first to IPDC parks and using off-grid solar/mini-grids for rural processing would raise export output faster than an even national rollout.
body.am: አዲስ አስተማማኝ MWን መጀመሪያ ለIPDC ፓርኮች መስጠት የወጪ ውጤትን ከእኩል ሀገራዊ ሽፋን በበለጠ ያሻሽላል።

body.en: WDI access does not measure hours per day or voltage quality. Industrial analysis needs SCADA-like park meters.
body.am: WDI መዳረሻ በቀን ሰዓት ወይም ቮልቴጅ አይለካም።

body.en: Dry years cut both farm output and generation. Energy and agriculture dashboards should be read together.
body.am: የድርቅ ዓመታት የእርሻ ውጤትን እና ማመንጨትን ይቀንሳሉ።

goal.en: Align training with job opportunities and incentivize startups.
goal.am: ስልጠናን ከሥራ ዕድል ጋር ማጣጣም እና ጅምር ሥራዎችን ማበረታታት።

overview.en: Ethiopia is a young country — median age 19 — and urban youth joblessness is the political and economic risk that national unemployment rates hide. Startups, incubators, and TVET seats are heavily Addis-centric. Mapping unemployment, funding, and incubator locations shows where the ecosystem is missing.
overview.am: ኢትዮጵያ ወጣት ሀገር ናት — መካከለኛ ዕድሜ 19 — የከተማ ወጣት ሥራ አጥነት የሀገር ሥራ አጥነት መጠን የሚደብቀው ስጋት ነው። ጅምር ሥራዎችና ኢንኩቤተሮች በአዲስ ያተኮሩ ናቸው።

definition.en: Age that splits the population in half.
ILO modelled unemployment; understates urban youth and informality.
definition.am: የILO ሥራ አጥነት፤ የከተማ ወጣትና መደበኛ ያልሆነን ይቀንሳል።

definition.en: Urban 15–29 unemployment / NEET relative to national.
Share of known incubators/accelerators outside the capital.
definition.am: ከዋና ከተማ ውጭ የታወቁ ኢንኩቤተሮች ድርሻ።

primary.name: Ethiopian Statistical Service, labour force survey

secondary.name: IceAddis, Gebeya, and university incubation reports
Jobs Creation Commission / Ministry of Labour

methodology.en: National unemployment is a poor youth metric in a largely informal economy. This map uses urban job pressure, park proximity, and a hand-compiled incubator count as the operational picture.
methodology.am: የሀገር ሥራ አጥነት በመደበኛ ባልሆነ ኢኮኖሚ ለወጣት ደካማ መለኪያ ነው።

title.en: The ecosystem is a capital-city object

body.en: IceAddis, Gebeya and most seed activity sit in Addis. Regional capitals have the youth and the industrial parks, not the incubators or the early cheques.
body.am: IceAddis፣ ገበያ እና አብዛኛው የዘር እንቅስቃሴ በአዲስ ነው። የክልል ዋና ከተሞች ወጣቱንና ፓርኮቹን አሏቸው እንጂ ኢንኩቤተሩን አይደለም።

body.en: Stand up lean campuses in Hawassa, Dire Dawa, Adama, Kombolcha and Mekelle (when operating conditions allow), tied to park procurement.
body.am: በሐዋሳ፣ ድሬ ዳዋ፣ አዳማ፣ ኮምቦልቻ ቀጭን ካምፓሶችን ከፓርክ ግዢ ጋር ያቁሙ።

body.en: Hypothetical: a youth employment fund that buys 20,000 park apprenticeships would move more 18–24 year-olds into wage work than an equivalent grant programme for untested startups.
body.am: 20,000 የፓርክ ልምምዶችን የሚገዛ የወጣት ሥራ ፈንድ ከእኩል የጅምር እርዳታ በበለጠ ወደ ደመወዝ ሥራ ያንቀሳቅሳል።

title.en: Startup funding is not a public series

body.en: There is no official rural or regional seed-funding dataset. Hub maps are compiled from known organisations and will undercount informal savings groups.
body.am: ኦፊሴላዊ የክልል የዘር ፈንድ ውሂብ የለም።

body.en: Many youth work without appearing in unemployment statistics. Policy should target quality of work, not only the headline rate.
body.am: ብዙ ወጣቶች በሥራ አጥነት ስታትስቲክስ ሳይታዩ ይሠራሉ።

goal.en: Model the impact of public-private partnerships on housing supply.
goal.am: የመንግሥት-ግል ሽርክና በመኖሪያ አቅርቦት ላይ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ መቅረጽ።

overview.en: Urban Ethiopia is adding households faster than formal units. Addis Ababa’s backlog, industrial-park worker housing, and secondary-city growth are three different shortages. A simple demand–supply frame — urban population growth versus construction — is enough to test whether PPPs close the gap or just relabel it.
overview.am: የከተማ ኢትዮጵያ ቤተሰቦችን ከመደበኛ ክፍሎች በበለጠ ታክላለች። የአዲስ ኋላ ቀርነት፣ የፓርክ ሠራተኛ መኖሪያ እና የሁለተኛ ከተማ ዕድገት ሦስት የተለያዩ እጥረቶች ናቸው።

definition.en: Annual urban population growth rate.
Order-of-magnitude formal unit deficit in the capital.
definition.am: በዋና ከተማ የመደበኛ ክፍል እጥረት መጠን።

definition.en: Integrated Housing Development Programme delivery vs waitlists.
Shortfall of affordable beds near major IPDC parks.
definition.am: በዋና IPDC ፓርኮች አጠገብ ተመጣጣኝ አልጋ እጥረት።

methodology.en: Demand is urban household formation (population and household size). Supply is formal completions plus a rough informal increment. PPP scenarios are mechanical: extra units per year, not a full financial model.
methodology.am: ፍላጎት የከተማ ቤተሰብ መፈጠር ነው። አቅርቦት መደበኛ ክፍሎች ነው። የPPP ሁኔታዎች ሜካኒካዊ ናቸው።

title.en: The expensive shortage is next to the parks

body.en: Hawassa and Bole Lemi shift losses are partly a housing story: long commutes, high rents, attrition. Worker housing is industrial policy, not only urban policy.
body.am: የሐዋሳና ቦሌ ለሚ ፈረቃ ኪሳራ በከፊል የመኖሪያ ታሪክ ነው።

body.en: Inventory and tender serviced plots within 5 km of five parks for PPP rental blocks with rent caps tied to park wages.
body.am: በአምስት ፓርኮች 5 ኪ.ሜ ውስጥ ያሉ ቦታዎችን ለPPP ኪራይ ሕንጻዎች ያቅርቡ።

body.en: Hypothetical: 10,000 extra formal units a year near parks and secondary cities would not clear the Addis backlog, but it would flatten industrial attrition and demonstrate a replicable PPP term sheet.
body.am: በዓመት 10,000 ተጨማሪ መደበኛ ክፍሎች የአዲስ ኋላ ቀርነትን አያጠፉም፤ የኢንዱስትሪ መልቀቅን ግን ይቀንሳሉ።

body.en: A large share of new urban shelter is informal. Official completions understate supply and hide quality and tenure risk.
body.am: አዲስ የከተማ መጠለያ ትልቅ ድርሻ መደበኛ ያልሆነ ነው።

body.en: FX moves and cement prices can invalidate a PPP model within a season. Any live dashboard needs a quarterly cost index.
body.am: የምንዛሬና የሲሚንቶ ዋጋ የPPP ሞዴልን በአንድ ወቅት ሊሽር ይችላል።

goal.en: Prioritize resilient seed distribution and water infrastructure.
goal.am: የጸና ዘር ስርጭትና የውሃ መሠረተ ልማትን ቅድሚያ መስጠት።

overview.en: Ethiopia’s disaster risk is geographic and seasonal: drought in the eastern and southern lowlands, riverine floods along the Awash and western basins, and compounding conflict that blocks response. A risk atlas that sits on NMA climatology and NDRMC history is the operational map for seeds, water, and pre-positioned aid.
overview.am: የኢትዮጵያ የአደጋ ስጋት ጂኦግራፊያዊና ወቅታዊ ነው፦ በምሥራቅና ደቡብ ቆላ ድርቅ፣ በአዋሽና ምዕራባዊ ተፋሰሶች ጎርፍ። በNMAና NDRMC ላይ የተቀመጠ አትላስ ለዘር፣ ውሃና እርዳታ የሥራ ካርታ ነው።

definition.en: People living in historically drought-affected livelihood zones.
definition.am: በታሪክ በድርቅ በተጎዱ የኑሮ ዞኖች ያሉ ሰዎች።

definition.en: Riverine and flash-flood exposure in kiremt.
Share of drought-prone woredas with pre-positioned adapted seed.
Boreholes, small irrigation and storage vs drought caseload.
definition.am: ጉድጓድ፣ ትንሽ መስኖና ማጠራቀሚያ ከድርቅ ጫና።

metrics.source: Ministry of Water and Energy / NDRMC

methodology.en: Risk scores combine historical NDRMC event frequency, FEWS NET livelihood-zone drought classification, and NMA seasonal climatology. They are not a live satellite flood product.
methodology.am: የስጋት ነጥቦች የNDRMC ክስተት ድግግሞሽ፣ FEWS NET እና NMA ወቅታዊ የአየር ሁኔታን ያጣምራሉ።

title.en: Afar is drought and flood at once
title.am: አፋር ድርቅና ጎርፍ አንድ ላይ ነው

body.en: The Awash belt can fail from both ends of the hydrograph. Water infrastructure there is dual-use: storage against drought and channels against flood.
body.am: የአዋሽ ቀበቶ ከሁለት ጫፍ ሊወድቅ ይችላል። የውሃ መሠረተ ልማት ለድርቅ ማጠራቀሚያና ለጎርፍ ቦይ ነው።

body.en: Move drought-tolerant packages into Somali, Afar and southern Oromia on the NMA outlook, not after failed rains. The logistics window is weeks, not months.
body.am: የድርቅ የሚቋቋሙ ጥቅሎችን ወደ ሶማሌ፣ አፋርና ደቡብ ኦሮሚያ በNMA ትንበያ ያንቀሳቅሱ።

title.en: Rank woredas, not regions, for water capex

body.en: Hypothetical: concentrating new boreholes and small irrigation in the top-decile drought woredas would reduce lean-season caseloads more than an even regional allocation — if conflict access is planned, not assumed.
body.am: አዲስ ጉድጓዶችን በከፍተኛ ድርቅ ወረዳዎች ማተኮር ከእኩል ክልላዊ ምደባ የበለጠ የረሃብ ወቅት ጫናን ይቀንሳል።

body.en: NDRMC reporting quality varies by region and year. Conflict years undercount. Use FEWS NET and WFP as a cross-check, not a replacement.
body.am: የNDRMC ሪፖርት ጥራት በክልልና በዓመት ይለያያል።

title.en: Climate is not the only shock

body.en: Access constraints can turn a moderate drought into a severe food-security event. The atlas must be read with humanitarian access maps.
body.am: የመዳረሻ ገደቦች መካከለኛ ድርቅን ወደ ከባድ የምግብ ቀውስ ሊለውጡት ይችላሉ።
